chapter: Music in the family, learning to play
title: Bass players: Netto's ear, Tony Lausa, Jack Abel
summary: Hirsch talks about electric and upright bass players, Frank Netto's perfect ear, and bassists who cannot play the changes.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: His son was playing drums with him. He's a good drummer, and they had a bass player over there. I don't know his name, but he's a member of our union. But he is one hell of a good bass player. I mean electric bass. He's got a beautiful ear. I made a record with him. I made a record with him. And this boy, he reminded me that he was Leon's piano player, a bass player. But he is one hell of a classy, faking bass player that plays another netto. But he plays electric. Doesn't play upright, huh?
I never heard him play upright. He was playing electric. It might have been Tim Jackson. I don't know but he was good. He was here in town. But he plays upright.
I'll tell you this was the thing about Netto. If Netto knew what Keya was in, he didn't make a mistake. And I mean even if the tune would digress from say a C to an A flat to an E major or from
He knew it. And a lot of these bass players, you're an exception. You didn't get my compliments.

But a lot of these bass players, when they start playing flat at 13ths and flat at 14ths and flat at 18ths, they don't know what the fuck they're doing. They're just hitting them on. I mean Tony Lausa is another one of those great. He can sing the Bachemagula or something like that but he can't play all the things you are. Is that right? No kidding. No. No bass. Jack Abel let him go. And Jack's got a pretty keen ear.

In fact I had Jack play out at the Norris Country Club. And he had a job earlier and I told him, I said don't worry, I'll play for a half hour until you get there. And I got out there for a half hour and believe me, he wasn't getting the same notes as I was. And I think I know what the notes are. Yeah. Yeah. But this boy was good and Leon's a well-school pianist. He's 90% bullshit but he's a good boy.
